parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203' AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
